title: Brazilian Artificial Intelligence Plan 2024–2028 (PBIA): AI for the Good of All
title_original: Plano Brasileiro de Inteligência Artificial (PBIA) 2024–2028 – IA para o Bem de Todos
summary: National AI plan drafted by the National Council for Science and Technology, approved on 29 July 2024 and presented to President Lula on 30 July 2024; MCTI coordinates it. It foresees R$ 23.03 billion of investment from 2024 to 2028 across 54 actions in immediate-impact actions and five axes: AI infrastructure and development, diffusion and training, AI for public services, AI for business innovation, and support for regulation and governance. Flagship actions include an AI supercomputer, Portuguese-language models trained on national data and a national AI observatory. A 15-member inter-ministerial working group created in May 2025 monitors execution.
beneficiaries: Researchers, companies, public services and AI professionals in Brazil
